title: Representations of Reeb spaces via simplified graphs and examples
summary: Reeb spaces of continuous real-valued functions on topological spaces are fundamental and strong tools in investigating the spaces. The Reeb space is the natural quotient space of the space of the domain represented by connected components of its level sets. They have appeared in theory of Morse functions in the last century and as important topological objects, they are shown to be graphs for tame functions on (compact) manifolds such as Morse(-Bott) functions and naturally generalized ones.
